geography: Worldwide total YORVIPATH revenue (Europe and international markets from January 2024; U.S. from late December 2024)
moa: Long-acting prodrug of parathyroid hormone PTH(1-34) (PTH receptor agonist)

launch_evidence.quote: YORVIPATH first launch in Germany January 2024

series_start_reason: YORVIPATH was approved in the EU before the U.S. and launched in Germany in January 2024; the first-quarter 2024 release is the first to print YORVIPATH revenue ('reflecting first two months of delivery to patients'). U.S. approval followed on 08/09/2024 and the U.S. launch in late December 2024 ('available in the U.S. since late December 2024', January 2025 presentation).
search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1612042 (Ascendis Pharma A/S) via data.sec.gov/submissions; every 6-K from 2021-08-01 to 2026-10-26 searched (all documents per filing except XBRL viewer pages) for 'skytrofa|yorvipath'; 20-F for 2021 read for the launch-quarter figure.
Each quarter read from the quarter's own results release: the YORVIPATH revenue sentence (EUR millions) for 2024Q1-Q3 and the revenue-from-commercial-products table (EUR'000) from 2024Q4.
